metrics.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
metrics.description: Gross revenue divided by completed order count

metrics.name: Order Cancellation Rate
metrics.description: Cancelled orders percentage of total orders
metrics.formula: ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0) * 100, 0), 2)::FLOAT

metrics.name: Hourly Run Rate
metrics.description: Average revenue generated per active hour
